# Vendored 1080 Motion API reference — READ ONLY

Read-only reference. Source of truth for PPA schema design. **Do not edit.**

Vendored from the `1080Motion/API` GitHub repository at commit
`3dc07c4a58fc0c3dfe066e9f7fd03cd654301281`.

Contents:
- `Protos/` — the canonical gRPC `.proto` schema. **This is the source of
  truth** for PPA model design (the REST view is a stripped-down subset).
- `openapi-v1.json` — the 1080 public REST API OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec (added by
  PPA; a simplified view of the proto schema).
- `Samples/` — official 1080 sample clients (.NET gRPC, .NET WebAPI, Python, R).
- `README.md`, `docs/` — upstream 1080 documentation.

The upstream `README.md` in this folder is the original 1080 file, left intact.
